Historical examples explain how to compare offers; they are not current admission or scholarship offers.","intro":"Bangladeshi students can apply to Chinese universities through a university admission route and, where eligible, a separate scholarship route. This guide brings together official examples so you can compare requirements and ask precise questions before paying.","eligibility":[{"title":"After HSC, A levels or equivalent","body":"Prepare your school graduation qualification and subject transcripts for an undergraduate assessment.
